homeText: Comprehensive reference for the Karui framework: routing, data loading, mutations, SSR and hydration, islands, metadata, static export, and the CLI.
aboutText: This docs site is built on Karui itself, without React.
docsHomeText: Pick a section to start. Fundamentals are recommended for first-time users.
heroSubtitle: A lightweight TypeScript framework with a keyed reconciler, real hydration, file-based routing, and a JSX runtime of its own. No React required.
featureSsrDesc: SSR with three hydration modes (full, islands, none) and hydration that adopts server markup instead of rebuilding it.
featureJsxDesc: Write JSX and use hooks without shipping React or Preact. Updates diff against the live DOM, so focus and input state survive.
featureRouterDesc: Intuitive folder structure handles static, dynamic, and catch-all routes.
